description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per payload - the payment buys one signed pre-flight lint of the one unsigned EVM (EIP-712) payload you submit: domain both-ways agreement, amount and descriptor-form checks against the published policy table, every finding named. The payload is never signed and never stored.

artefact.description: The one unsigned payload artefact in the published submission form for the op (EVM: the EIP-712 descriptor form; SVM: the instruction-descriptor form). Processed in memory only, never stored, never signed.

name: payload_preflight_evm
